report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Hipótesis diagnóstica: SINDROME PATELOFEMORAL BILATERAL
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservados, sin criterios de rotura. Pequeño ganglión intraóseo
de 7 mm adyacente a la raíz anterior del menisco medial.
Cartílago femorotibial con alteración de señal y discreta regularidad superficial, sin defectos
condrales profundos.
Cartílago rotuliano con alteración de señal y defectos de espesor parcial y subtotal, algunos
delaminativos, en ambas vertientes y vértice la patela destacando una úlcera profunda con
cambios óseos reactivos en el vértice.
Cartílago troclear con discreta irregularidad superficial en la región central.
Tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
No hay derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker. Edema del aspecto superolateral de la
grasa de Hoffa.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados.
Impresión:
Condropatía femorotibial superficial.
Condropatía rotuliana con focos grado 3 y 4.
Condropatía superficial en la región central de la tróclea.
Signos de hiperpresión patelar externa

Intraosealna ganglion cista promjera do 15 mm u posterionom dijelu medijalnog kondila femura
uz okolnu zonu koštanog edema. Uz nju kaudalno cista istih karakteristika promjera 8 mm.
Opisano vjerojatno uslijed degenerativno promijenjenog hvatišta tetive medijalne gleave m.
gastrocnemius.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Prikaže se hondromalacija I° hrskavice oba tibijalna platoa te II° oba kondila femura. Sužen ia.
prostor femorotibijalnog zgloba, izraženije medijalno.
Subhondralni edem medijalne fasete patele uz erozije hrskavice obje fasete u sklopu OA
promjena.
OA promjene femorotibijalog i femoropatelarnog zgloba umjerenog stupnja.
Prednji križni ligament promijenjenog inteziteta signala u smislu umjerene mukoidne
degeneracije.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Degenerativne promjene medijalnog meniska uz kompleksnu, predominantno horizontalnu rupturu
stražnjeg roga i dijela trupa s ekstruzijom pod MCL.
Mukoidna degeneracija lateralnog meniska bez znakova rupture.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament je entezopatski promijenjen pri hvatištu za lateralni epikondil
femura.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuitata, distendiran ekstrudiranim meniskom, uz
periligamentarno prisutnu tekućinu.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva m. kvadriepsa primjerenog prikaza.
Patelarni ligamnet je održanog kontinuiteta, uz znakove entezopatskih promjena i
periligamentarni edem.
Patelarni retinakulumi su stanjeni pri hvatištu na patelu, medijalni smanjene napetosti i
promijenjenih intenziteta signala - ranija ozljeda?
Manja količina izljeva u zglob.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.

Erhaltene Artikulation im rechten Kniegelenk. Deutliches Ödem in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie im medialen Tibiaplateau. Kleinzystische Veränderungen subcortikal an der Patellafacette (5/9). Ansonsten unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Patella zentriert stehend.
Tief greifende chondrale Läsion an der lateralen Patellafacette mit ca. 5 x 7 mm (4/15 oder 7/22). Darunterliegende kleinzystische Veränderungen subcortikal. Weitere tief greifende chondrale Läsion auch an der medialen Patellafacette mit chondraler Ossifikationen mit ca. 6 x 6 mm (4/14 und 7/18). An den Femurkondylen der facies patellaris oberflächliche Chondropathie mit ausgedünntem Knorpelbelag. Auch femorotibial, führend medialseitig multiple tief greifende kontralaterale Läsionen, exemplarisch in der Hauptbelastungszone mit bis zu 4 mm (5/22) oder dorsal an der medialen Femurkondyle (5/24). Am medialen Tibiaplateau zudem kleine osteochondrale Läsion (5/20). Auch lateralseitig führend am dorsalen Tibiaplateau vollschichtige Chondropathie mit darunterliegenden kleinzystischen Veränderungen (1006/82). Die Kreuzbänder intakt. Diskrete Signalanhebung im Außenmeniskushinterhorn und im Bereich der anterioren Anheftungsstelle (6/22), DD bei mukoider Degeneration. Das Innenmeniskushinterhorn ebenfalls deutlich T2 signalalteriert mit komplexer in erster Linie degenerativer Rissbildung im Hinterhorn bis in die Pars intermedia (siehe z. B. 5/22). Der Innenmeniskus bereits gering exkludiert. LCL unauffällig. Schmaler Flüssigkeitssaum Umgebend zum MCL, DD bei Reizzustand. Moderater Gelenkerguss. Synoviale Proliferationen. Minimal Flüssigkeit an Baker Position (3/90). Ansonsten unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Weichteile.

PDFS mrljasti hiperintenziteti u području femura u sklopu rekonverzije koštane srži.
Uredan intenzitet signala svih koštanih struktura, bez znakova frakture, koštanog edema ili
osteonekroze.
Hondromalacija I° femoralne i tibijalne hrskavice medijalnog zglobnog kompartmenta te
patelarne hrskavice u području lateralne fasete. Uredan intenzitet signala ostalih zglobnih
hrskavica.
Nema signifikantnog zglobnog izljeva.
Prednji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Medijalni menisk diskretno povišenih intenziteta signala u stražnjem rogu, ddg. početne deg.
promjene. Bez znakova akutne rupture.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Lateralni i medijalni kolateralni ligamenti urednog signala te se prate u kontinuitetu.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Primjerena morfologija ilitibijalnog trakta i pes anserinusa.
Medijalni i lateralni patelarni retinakulum urednog intenziteta signala i održanog kontinuiteta.
Bez znakova poplitealne ciste.

Knochen: Gering Knochenmarksödem an der medialen Femurkondyle in der subchondralen Belastungszone (5/24). Gering zystische Veränderungen der Knochenstruktur am Patellaoberpol (5/7). Desweiteren unauffälliges Knochenmarkssignal. Zentrierte Stellung im Kniegelenk. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella. Einzelne intraossäre Zyste des distalen Femurs intercondylär (5/18). 
Knorpel: Fokal bis vollschichtige Chondropathie retropatellar am Patellafirst (4/12 + 14). An der Trochlea ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz. Ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz an der medialen Femurkondyle im Femorotibialgelenk, fokal mit bis vollschichtiger Chondropathie (6/11+ 5/21). Keine höhergradige Chondropathie im lateralen Kompartiment. 
Kreuzbänder: Intakte Darstellung des Faserverlauf sowie Signalgebung des hinteren Kreuzbandes. Kräftiges anteriores meniscofemorales Ligament. Intakter Verlauf des vorderen Kreuzbandes.
Menisci: Mucoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskusvorderhornes, geringer mucoide Degeneration am Innenmeniskushinterhorn. Keine Rissbildung oder Herniation. Keine parameniscealen Zysten. 
Gelenkkapsel/Kollateralbänder: Gering Gelenkerguss führend suprapatellar. Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. Mediales und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Geringer Reizzustand des MCL. 
Fettkörper: Unauffällig, kein raumfordernder Prozess. 
Weichteile: CC bis 8 cm ausgedehnte polylobulierte Baker-Zyste in Loco typico (6/5, 5/33).

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı minimal artmış. Distal femur proksimal tibya ve fibula diyafizometafizer kesimlerindeki artmış hematopoitik kemik iliği aktivitesi anemi ile birlikte olabilir. Çapraz ve yan bağlar normal. Lateral menisküs normal. Medyal menisküs arka boynuzu-gövdesindeki dejenerasyona gövdesi düzeyindeki doku kaybının da eşlik ettiği kompleks yırtık ve medyale 5 mm ekstrüzyon eşlik ediyor. Ekstrüde disk iç yan bağı basılıyor ve iç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Çapraz ve dış yan bağ normal. Popliteus tendinozisi insersiyosu düzeyinde ve hafif derecede. Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal patellar faset santralindeki tam kata ulaşan kondral fissür, medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki segmenter tam kat kondral kayıp, eşlik eden subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve milimetrik boyutlu marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Gastroknemyus semimembranozus bursasındaki 4 cm maksimum boyutlu lobüle konturlu sıvı koleksiyonu sızdırmıyor. Prepatellar ve yüzeyel infrapatellar derin cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Ekstensör mekanizma korunmuş. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior horn gövde düzeyine ulaşan horizontal yırtık izlendi. Medial menisküs mediale doğru hafif ekstrude görünümdedir. Lateral menisküste grade I dejenerasyon izlendi. Ön çapraz bağ sinyali özellikle proksimalde diffüz artmıştır (grade I sprain).  Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem ile uyumlu görünüm izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.

Técnica: RMN de la rodilla. Resultados: Rotura de menisco interno. Derrame. Condropatía rotuliana lateral. Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa. Impresión: Rotura de menisco interno. Derrame. Síndrome de pinzamiento de la almohadilla grasa de Hoffa.

MRI  KNEE  -  RIGHT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Suspected large and destructive meniscal tear hindering mobility.

COMPARISON:  Knee x-rays [Date].

FINDINGS:

Medial meniscus: Oblique tear of the posterior medial meniscus with inferior articular surfacing. Incidental meniscal flounce.

Medial compartment articular cartilage:  Grade 2 chondrosis with mild degenerative changes, including osteophyte formation.

MCL:  Mild thickening, consistent with chronic sprain.

Lateral meniscus: The lateral meniscus is peripherally extruded and macerated, consistent with extensive complex degenerative tear. 

Lateral compartment articular cartilage:  Grade 4 chondrosis with complete denuding of the articular surface and extensive degenerative changes, including bone-on-bone articulation, subchondral edema and cystic change, and osteophyte formation.

LCL complex:  Intact.

ACL:  Intact.

PCL:  Intact.

Quadriceps and patellar tendons:  Intact.

Patellofemoral alignment: Normal.

Patellofemoral cartilage:  Grade 1 chondrosis with mild degenerative changes.

Joint effusion:  Small volume effusion mostly in the suprapatellar recess.

Intra-articular bodies:  0.3 x 1.1 cm mineralized body in the posterior joint space.

Bone marrow:  Subchondral edema involving the lateral tibial plateau and lateral femoral condyle.

Popliteal fossa:  Normal.

Other findings:  Mild subcutaneous edema mostly over the lateral aspect of the knee. Fatty atrophy of the medial gastrocnemius muscle.


INTERPRETATION:

The lateral compartment is completely attenuated with bone-on-bone articulation and extensive degenerative changes. The lateral meniscus is nearly completely extruded and macerated, consistent with with an extensive complex degenerative tear.

Oblique tear of the posterior medial meniscus with inferior articular surfacing. 

Mild patellofemoral and medial compartment degenerative changes. Small joint effusion.

The extensor mechanism, LCL complex, MCL, ACL, and PCL are intact.

MRI of right Knee with 
-3-Plane Loc RT, Sag PD FS, Sag T2 FS, Sag T1, Cor T2 FS, Ax T2 FS


> The contour of ACL and PCL in a straight line but slight increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of degeneration of grade 1 injury.
> Linear signal intensity in anteriot and posterior horn of medial meniscus with extending into the surface and suspicious of tiny cystic like focus abutting anterior horn, in favor of meniscus tear with tiny parameniscal cyst  (Srs/Img: [ID].
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal, maybe due to degeneration.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion with hypertrophy of the synovium and suprapatellar, lateral and medial plicae, indicative of synovitis.
> Subcutaneous infiltration over anterior aspect of right knee.
> Mild tendinosis of quadriceps tendon
> Small osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of right knee, reflecting osteoarthritis; tiny subchondral cystic change in posterior lateral femoral condyle.
  Suspicious of tiny cystic change or vessel over subchondral region of lateral patella.

Impression: 
1. Osteoarthritis of right knee, more prominent at lateral compartment, with grade 3-4 chondromalacia.
2. Bucket handle tear of lateral meniscus with R/O small parameniscal cyst; degeneration of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Mild synovitis of right knee and patellar plicae.
4. Degeneration or grade 1 injury of ACL and PCL.
5. Tendinosis of distal quadriceps tendon.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and physical examination

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
There is a small suprapatellar joint effusion.
No popliteal cyst.

There is superior popliteal multilocular ganglion cyst, about 1.6 x 0.8 cm in the transverse and anteroposterior dimensions and around 3.75 cm longitudinally with a small neck extending to the posterior capsule.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Mild degenerative chondropathy in the medial femorotibial compartment, with diffuse partial thickness cartilage thinning, without subchondral bony changes or deep cartilage fissuring.

The medial meniscus is normal without discrete tear.

Mild thickening with surrounding edematous changes in the proximal medial collateral ligament in keeping with grade 1 sprain.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
The lateral femoral compartment shows mild diffuse cartilage thinning without subchondral bony changes or deep fissuring.

The lateral meniscus is normal without discrete tear.

The lateral collateral ligament complex and the popliteus tendon are normal without discrete tearing.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
There is complete tear in the proximal anterior cruciate ligament. The posterior cruciate ligament is normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Severe degenerative chondropathy in the patellofemoral compartment, with multifocal full-thickness cartilage fissuring and subchondral bony changes in the medial and lateral patellar facets. There is deep fissuring also in the femoral trochlea.

The extensor mechanism is normal.

Bones:
Bone contusions at the posterolateral tibial plateau with a small linear subchondral low signal intensity [series 6, image 30] suggesting microtrabecular fracture/impaction.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:

1. Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.

2. Grade 1 sprain of the proximal medial collateral ligament.

3. Focal bone contusion of the posterolateral tibial plateau with microtrabecular fracture/impaction. The posterolateral corner shows no discrete tear including the popliteus tendon and lateral collateral ligament.

4. Degenerative chondropathy in the medial femorotibial and patellofemoral compartments, severe in the patellofemoral compartment with multifocal full-thickness cartilage fissuring and subchondral bony changes as described.

Moderate suprapatellar joint effusion, communicating with a tiny non ruptured Baker's cyst, there are no intra-articular bodies.  
An extensive, complex degenerative tear is affecting the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with consequent medial extrusion at the level of the body. There are no concurrent displaced meniscal fragments.  
Intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, distal iliotibial band and the extensor tendons. No fracture or marrow infiltration. Mild relative thinning of medial weightbearing articular cartilage, otherwise well-maintained articular cartilage surfaces.  
As already seen contralaterally, there is non complicated distal insertional semimembranosus tendinopathy. 
Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG T2W FS, SG PD FatSat, CO T2W FS, SG T1W, AX T2W FS


> Lobulated cystic lesion with internal septums in medial popliteal region and extending into the gastrocnemiosemimembranous bursa, about 3*4*7 cm in size, in favor of Baker's cyst with perifocal edema.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and lateral plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, and absent bow-tie sign,  in favor of tear.
> Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
> Tortuosity and enorgment of the superficial vein and enlarged caliber of popliteal vein.
> The contour of ACL is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside distal portion, in favor of tear.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Degeneration of left knee joint with large osteophyte and wearing articular cartilage and subchondral cysts in medial aspect of knee joint.
> Subcutaneous edema around knee.

Impression: 
1. Baker's cyst with perifocal edema.
2. Tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus.
3. Osteoarthritis of left knee.
4. Synovitis and suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
5. Varicose veins.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn. No extrusion. No displaced fragments. No peri-meniscal cysts.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse partial thickness chondrosis of the weightbearing aspect of the femoral condyle with some full thickness fissuring along the weightbearing portions of the condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Areas of full-thickness chondrosis involving the medial patellar facet extending to the median eminence. Associated subchondral bone marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.

Зад задната кръстна връзка се вижда овална лезия с костноеквивалентна сигнална характеристика и размери 10,5/4,7мм. Лезия с идентична структура се вижда вътреставно медиолатерално отпред пред предната кръстна връзка и големина 17,8/8мм. Трета подобна лезия се открива дорзално до медиалния фемурален кондил с големина 7мм. Находките съответстват на вътреставни мишки. В хрущяла на фемура вентрално и медиално под нивото на пателата се виждат дефекти, без данни за костномозъчен едем субхондрално. Ставният хрущял на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна на ставата се лекостепенно изтънен. По медиалната и латералната страна на кондилите и епикондилите на тибията и фемура се изобразяват остеофитни наслагвания. Субхондрално и дорзално по латералния кондил на тибията се намира малка дегенеративна киста с размер 5/2мм. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Нормално изобразяване на медиалния и латералния менискус. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Меки тъкани – б.о. Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec un petit kyste poplité non-rupturé.

Il y a changements dégénératifs sévères au niveau patellofémoral avec perte de cartilage complet à la facette latérale et à la partie latérale de la trochlée du fémur avec changements réactifs sous-chondraux plus proéminents au niveau de la rotule. Il y a aussi changements dégénératifs légers à modérés du compartiment interne avec amincissement et perte de cartilage plus proéminent à la partie centrale du condyle fémoral interne. Il y a aussi un léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment externe.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il y a une déchirure horizontale surajoutée. La déchirure s’étend de la corne postérieure jusqu’au niveau du corps. La déchirure s’étend à la surface articulaire inférieure du ménisque. Il n’y a pas de fragment déplacé. Il y a un petit kyste para-méniscal adjacent à la corne postérieure. Le ménisque externe démontre changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps sans déchirure linéaire bien définie.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminent au niveau patellofémoral tel que détaillé ci-haut.

2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance des ménisques avec déchirure horizontale surajoutée du ménisque interne tel que détaillé ci-haut.

3. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec petit kyste poplité.
